known_limitations: Single teacher temperature 0.6; no within-task candidate diversity, so per-task yield is expected to be ~0.9 rows (one candidate per task).
The teacher and user simulator use the same model family, so same-source bias remains and is recorded, not hidden.
Task-level environment poisoning (e.g., tool errors) is not preventable at generation; it is detected post-hoc by the audit and held out.
Layer-2 yield (retained rate, REJECTED rate) is unknown until the run completes; estimate is ~28-30 retained from 33 tasks.
AUTO_PASS_CANDIDATE is not human-adjudicated GOLD and is not SFT-releasable.
Programmatic policy findings remain diagnostic until validated against human gold.
